etymology: from a prolonged form of the prepositional prefix m- and 01 from (her [the mother's]) father
partOfSpeech: n pr m, n pr loc
definition:
Moab = "of his father"

 n pr m
 1) a son of Lot by his eldest daughter
 2) the nation descended from the son of Lot

 n pr loc
 3) the land inhabited by the descendants of the son of Lot
